# PrivaGlobe

> PrivaGlobe is a data privacy consultancy based in Mumbai, India. We provide consulting, implementation, documentation, audits, DPO as a Service and privacy software for India's DPDP Act, the EU and UK GDPR, US CCPA/CPRA, the PDPA of Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, and Saudi Arabia's PDPL. Contact: contact@privaglobe.com, +91 70210 17952.

Guidance pages show a "Last reviewed" date. Key DPDP dates: Rules notified 13 November 2025; consent manager framework starts 13 November 2026; main obligations and penalties apply from 13 May 2027.

## Services and laws
- [DPDP compliance consultant in India](https://www.privaglobe.com/dpdp-compliance-consultant-india/): obligations, dates, penalties and how we help with India's DPDP Act
- [GDPR consulting](https://www.privaglobe.com/gdpr-consulting/): scope, lawful basis, transfers, EU representatives, fines
- [DPO as a Service](https://www.privaglobe.com/dpo-as-a-service-india/): when a DPO is required and how an outsourced DPO works
- [CCPA and CPRA compliance](https://www.privaglobe.com/ccpa-cpra-compliance-consulting/): thresholds, consumer rights, opt-outs, penalties
- [PDPA: Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand](https://www.privaglobe.com/pdpa-compliance-singapore-malaysia-thailand/): three laws compared
- [Saudi PDPL compliance](https://www.privaglobe.com/saudi-pdpl-compliance-consulting/): controller duties, transfers, penalties
- [Privacy management software](https://www.privaglobe.com/privacy-management-software-india/): consent, rights requests, data mapping, DPIAs, breach tracking
